## Tutorial checklist

- [ ] The tutorial is stored in `src/content/posts/`.
- [ ] The frontmatter matches the content collection schema.
- [ ] The guide includes introduction, requirements, steps, common errors and conclusion.
- [ ] The post uses existing categories/tags when possible.
- [ ] The post is marked `draft: false` only if it is ready to publish.
- [ ] Commands were tested or reviewed for accuracy.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally.
